nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Documents the Stage-3 React/TypeScript JARVIS HUD: a read-only consumer of the dev_graph that explains the src layout (typed data layer, pure question to answer router, hooks, components), the npm run/test/build commands, and the offline graph.json vs live Neo4j bridge sourcing model.
nodes.languageNotes: Emphasizes the projection chain (graph.json is generated, never hand-edited) and ADR-010's read-only consumer constraint.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Vite HTML entry point for the JARVIS HUD; sets the jarvis data-theme, preloads Google display fonts, and mounts the React app from /src/main.tsx into the #root div.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: npm manifest for the el-nino-jarvis-hud React app declaring dev/build/preview/test scripts (Vite + tsc + Vitest) and dependencies on react, react-dom, and cytoscape for graph rendering.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the HUD: ES2021/ESNext modules with bundler resolution, react-jsx, strict mode plus noUnused checks, and noEmit (Vite handles emission).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses moduleResolution: bundler with allowImportingTsExtensions and noEmit, the standard Vite type-check-only setup.
